title: A review of research progress on prevention and control technologies for arsenic and cadmium composite pollution in paddy soil
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,571-583
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00293H, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hao Cui, Bingbing Chen, Fan Yang, Tao Han, Rui Zeng, Lidan Lei, Songqing Liu
Arsenic and cadmium in paddy soils pose food safety risks in China due to their transfer to rice grains. This review explores various remediation techniques, highlighting the need for integrated, region-specific solutions to reduce contamination.
